title: Elf Bar 600 Peach Ice Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: The Elf Bar 600 Peach Ice Prefilled Pods bring a refreshing fruit-and-ice blend to the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and provides up to 600 puffs, with a smooth MTL vaping experience. The flavour layers juicy, sweet Peach with an icy breeze on the exhale, offering a bright and cooling vape that remains satisfying throughout. Pods are quick to swap—simply click in a fresh one when empty for hassle-free vaping.
